title: Homework Kahan Hai?
text:
टीचर: होमवर्क कहाँ है?
छात्र: सर, कॉपी घर पर रह गई।
टीचर: और कॉपी कहाँ है?
छात्र: सर, वो भी होमवर्क का इंतज़ार कर रही है। 📚

title: Last Bench
text:
Last bench par baithne walon ki
do hi skills hoti hain:
Teacher ke aane se pehle alert dena,
aur exam me bhi confidence na khona. 😎

title: Exam ka Paper
text:
Paper dekha.
Pehla question: nahi aata.
Doosra: nahi aata.
Teesra: naam likhna tha —
chalo kuch toh aaya. ✍️

title: Games Period
text:
Poore hafte ka sabse bada tyohaar:
Games period.
Aur uska sabse bada dukh:
"Aaj ground geela hai, class me baitho." ⚽

title: Tiffin ka Hisaab
text:
School me tiffin 3rd period me hi khatam ho jaata tha.
Lunch time me sirf dabba bachta tha
aur uske saath ek lambi kahani
ki "bahut bhookh lag gayi thi." 🍱

title: Surprise Test
text:
टीचर: आज सरप्राइज़ टेस्ट है।
क्लास: सर, कम से कम बता तो देते।
टीचर: बता देता तो सरप्राइज़ कैसा?
क्लास: और हम पास कैसे होते? 😭

title: Topper ki Copy
text:
Topper: Maine kuch nahi padha.
Result: 98%.
Main: Maine sach me kuch nahi padha.
Result: sach hi nikla. 📉

title: School Bus
text:
School bus me window seat ke liye jo daud lagti thi,
usme jo stamina tha,
agar wahi ground me hota
toh aaj desh ke liye medal aata. 🚌

title: Principal Office
text:
Life ka sabse lamba raasta:
Class se principal ke office tak ka 30 kadam ka corridor. 🚪

title: Maths ka Sawaal
text:
Maths: Ek aadmi ne 40 tarbooz khareede.
Main: Kyun? Kaunsa insaan 40 tarbooz khareedta hai?
Teacher: Sawaal solve karo.
Main: Pehle uski mental health check kijiye. 🍉

title: Handwriting
text:
Teacher: Tumhari handwriting samajh nahi aati.
Main: Sir, mujhe bhi nahi aati.
Teacher: Toh likha kyun?
Main: Ummeed thi ki aapko aa jaayegi. 🖊️

title: Nayi Copy
text:
Nayi copy ka pehla page
itni sundar handwriting se bharte the
jaise poori zindagi badalne wali ho.
Doosre page se wahi purani haalat. 📓

title: Present Sir
text:
Attendance me "Yes sir" bolne ka apna hi style hota tha.
Kisi ka romantic, kisi ka dramatic,
aur ek banda hamesha der se bolta tha —
wo aaj bhi late hi aata hai. ✋

title: Science Practical
text:
Practical me sabse pehle observation likha,
phir experiment kiya,
aur result pehle se pata tha.
Science ko humne reverse engineer kar diya tha. 🔬

title: Chhutti ki Ghanti
text:
Duniya ka sabse sureela sangeet:
school ki aakhri ghanti.
Uske aage koi symphony kuch nahi. 🔔

title: Group Project
text:
Group project me 5 log hote hain:
1 kaam karta hai,
2 idea dete hain,
1 gayab rehta hai,
aur 1 presentation wale din naya naam suggest karta hai. 📽️
